title: Strategy ledger
idea: Strategy ledger: Resources production and commitments reconcile across a turn
audience: People who need to manage economy within a game surface.
avoidWhen: There is no strategic resource tradeoff
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its manage economy priority and explicit commitment contract: Turn execution reconciles resource constraints atomically
navigation: Strategy ledger keeps the current manage economy context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Resources production and commitments reconcile across a turn
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to manage economy; players compare finite production choices
composition.priority: Turn execution reconciles resource constraints atomically

imagery.role: Support the actual manage economy context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Use aligned units and focusable drill-down instead of tiny icons
Compose for safe zones, aspect ratio and the actual input device; preserve world readability.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the strategy ledger structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no manage economy content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Turn execution reconciles resource constraints atomically
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized manage economy content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Turn execution reconciles resource constraints atomically
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active manage economy context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure frame-time and input latency in the real engine; DOM checks cannot certify in-world UI.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
